written.title: GTA's Jason Duval And Link Make Their Pitch To Players On SNL
written.description: What IGN, Kotaku, PC Gamer and Polygon reported about Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos on 4 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## IGN, 4 October 2026

[Jason and Link Show Up for SNL in New Weekend Update Skit About GTA 6 vs. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake](https://www.ign.com/articles/snl-weighs-in-on-gta-6-vs-the-legend-of-zelda-with-skit-featuring-jason-and-link)

The outlet's own summary:

> SNL weighed in on GTA 6 vs. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake with a new Weekend Update skit featuring video game protagonists Jason Duval and Link.

> The Legend of Zelda With Skit Featuring Jason and Link TMPNG.

> The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake with a new Weekend Update skit featuring video game protagonists Jason Duval and Link.

> The bit starred live-action versions of GTA 6's Jason and The Legend of Zelda's Link, played by Marcello Hernández and Mikey Day, respectively, and mostly saw the two icons arguing about who has the better game.

> The long-running celebrity skit show is no stranger to nights like this, and although it's been known to feature the odd gaming reference here and there , it's safe to say full-on appearances from Link and Jason probably weren't on anyone's bingo card.

> The outfit that helped him bring Jason to life, meanwhile, is little more than a bloody bandage and a tropical button-up.

> While this Jason falls more into the last-minute Halloween-costume category, Day's Link getup has received praise for being shockingly accurate to the character's specific Ocarina of Time remake tunic.

## Kotaku, 4 October 2026

[GTA's Jason Duval And Link Make Their Pitch To Players On SNL](https://kotaku.com/gta-vis-jason-duval-and-link-make-their-final-pitch-on-saturday-night-live-2000739644)

The outlet's own summary:

> Wait Colin Jost is seriously still at the Weekend Update desk? Does he not have anywhere else to go?

> Hopefully Jason didn’t stray too far off from his designated path backstage, or Land Shark might’ve gotten him . 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips.

> Vying to be November’s biggest video game, the two stars trade barbs for several minutes, largely revolving around how effeminate Link’s appearance is and how lunkheaded life in Vice City gets.

> There on behalf of Michael Showalter’s first thriller Verity (hearing it’s decent), Baltimore rock band Turnstile made their Studio 8H debut and Taylor Swift crashed the opening monologue.

> The two eventually wave rocket launcher and fairy bottle props at each other.

## PC Gamer, 4 October 2026

[GTA 6 won't be letting up on the satire: 'sometimes you need to forego realism'](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-wont-be-letting-up-on-the-satire-if-you-are-going-to-put-all-this-effort-into-creating-a-version-of-todays-world-it-has-to-be-more-over-the-top-more-insane-more-in-your-face/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Lucia and Jason's appearance in a fashion magazine gives us a couple more titbits of GTA info.

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> The other focus of the article is on Lucia, GTA's first fully voiced woman protagonist, and on her relationship with co-star Jason.

## Polygon, 4 October 2026

[Link And GTA 6's Jason Get Into A Heated Debate In Hilarious SNL Bit](https://www.polygon.com/saturday-night-live-zelda-vs-gta-6/)

The outlet's own summary:

> SNL's Weekend Update tackled the year's biggest gaming debate: Should you play GTA 6 or the Ocarina of Time remake in November?

> Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced's best weapon isn't Edward's Hidden Blade Pokémon Go leader counters for Sierra, Arlo, and September in October 2026 Thread 1 Sign in to your Polygon.com account We want to hear from you.

> SNL claims GTA 6's focus on sex, chaos, and destruction is why it has a bigger audience The Weekend Update segment, which stars Mikey Day as Link and Marcello Hernandez as Jason, features a lot of trash-talking.

> Jason criticizes Ocarina of Time due to its lack of sex appeal, violence, fun items, and "baddies," whereas Grand Theft Auto VI revels in "destruction, chaos, and sex." While it's ultimately a lighthearted bit, it gets to the heart of why GTA 6 has become such a widely anticipated game, even among people who don't typically play games.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
